_help: Request settings for VoiceStudio's /v1/audio/speech, one per voice in tools/narrate.js. 'model' is the engine id (omnivoice is the default engine). With omnivoice, 'instruct' designs the voice from tags, and a fixed 'seed' keeps it the same across every clip. To use a cloned voice, set 'voice' to its VoiceStudio profile id and drop 'instruct'. Changing a voice re-speaks everything that uses it.
